citation.authors: Hamann CR, Boonchai W, Wen L, Sakanashi EN et al
citation.journal: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology

record.population: 549 skin-lightening products from 32 countries bought in the US, Taiwan, Japan, China, Thailand and Sri Lanka
record.finding: 33 products (6.0%) contained mercury above 1,000 ppm, and 45% of the mercury-containing samples contained more than 10,000 ppm. Of products bought in the US, 3.3% had mercury over 1,000 ppm. The US legal limit is 1 ppm.
record.note: Product testing, not a study of people. One sample per product.
